scientific_question: Does the frozen procedural chart reproduce the already accepted late c_proj band 8-11 throughout the dense-parent trajectory, or is dense-parent phase replay itself an invalid proxy for the co-adapted procedural path?

theory.factorial_control: The selected terminal mask makes layers 4-11 procedural. Factor the same-gauge endpoint into late-only layers 8-11 and middle-only layers 4-7 while leaving every other parameter fixed.
theory.accepted_band_control: Layers 8-11 are the only c_proj band with an independently trained same-gauge LWT acceptance result. Failure of their dense-parent replay would invalidate the current phase proxy rather than justify another chart sweep.
theory.middle_band_localization: If late-only passes every phase while middle-only fails, the path mismatch is specifically caused by extending procedural c_proj into layers 4-7.
theory.interaction: The already sealed combined gaps permit a 2x2 factorial interaction calculation without another combined evaluation or post-result threshold choice.
theory.scope: This test measures functional phase capacity only. It does not train, fit thresholds, select layers, change the chart, or authorize a candidate implementation.

decision_rule.late_proxy_failure: Authorize only a full-state trajectory acquisition of the already accepted late-band structure. Do not infer that its trained path fails from a dense-parent replay.
decision_rule.middle_only_failure: Localize the dense-parent path failure to layers 4-7 and retain the accepted late 8-11 allocation; do not launch the expansion.
decision_rule.interaction_failure: If each band passes alone but the sealed combination fails, attribute the mismatch to cross-band coupling and require a new theory before intervention.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
